{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs/task-15dbed0a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    min_r = min(r for r, c, v in cells)
    max_c = max(c for r, c, v in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r, c, v in cells)
    max_r = max(r for r, c, v in cells)
    # Shear each row right by its vertical offset, keeping the object's
    # rightmost extent anchored at the same column; clip at the grid edge.
    offset = max_c - ((max_c - min_c) + (max_r - min_r))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, c, v in cells:
        nc = c - min_c + (r - min_r) + offset
        if 0 <= nc < w:
            out[r][nc] = v
    return out
"
}
